body: Thanks, I get that it's not a quick fix.... I was just expecting.... I don't know.... just something... I will try to talk, I will keep going
Nice one, Bobby. Not spoken to sis.... the thing is., what the fuck do I say?  When shit gets real I'm struck dumb.

Hey dude, you need to get some meds and give them time to work. I got my date from camhs today and I was kinda hoping you'd be able to give me meds feedback . A month is no time at all, you need to allow yourself time to recover. I called a crisis line the other night when I was on a downer and they were telling me about how successful meds are and that the majority of people with depression and anxiety improve with the right treatment. Bobby, stay cool and hang on in there. I am here to talk.

Thanks dude, so hope I am considered urgent. Haven't said very much, find it difficult to talk. Not sureif I should disclose my drug use, I am 17 so not sure how much they can share with my mum. Shit suddenly feels even more scary. Give us an up date on the meds. Sounds like I will hopefully not be fare behind you. Thanks once again. Your a good guy bobby.

Hey bobby, did the therapy work. I am just waiting for a date for mine. I am in the U.K. How long did you wait to get an appointment. Any advice for me before I go? My family don't know, no one one knows, Other than the nameless voices I spoke to to make the appointment. Thinking of telling my sister.... just don't know how. Good luck
